E2409

`#RenameAll({style})` isn't a known casing style.

What

`#RenameAll({style})` isn't a known casing style.

Why

The wire-casing menu is the closed typed set `camel`/`snake`/`pascal`/`kebab`/`screaming` (D-SERDE3); anything else is rejected so a typo fails at compile time, not on the wire.

Fix

Pick one of `camel` / `snake` / `pascal` / `kebab` / `screaming`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2409: tests/ui/serde_rename_all_bad_style.stderr.

Error [E2409]: `#[RenameAll(shouty)]` isn't a known casing style
  --> tests/ui/serde_rename_all_bad_style.jet:3:22
    |
  3 | #[Codable, RenameAll(shouty)]
    |                      ^^^^^^
 Why: the wire-casing menu is `camel`, `snake`, `pascal`, `kebab`, `screaming`
 Fix: pick one of `camel` / `snake` / `pascal` / `kebab` / `screaming`
